🚨 BREAKING: The unsealed search warrant documents on Ilhan Omar just dropped, and they are an absolute disaster for her AND for Obama Judge James Boasberg.

First, federal prosecutors are investigating alleged crimes spanning "between 1980 to the present," writing in court filings that the United States believes "Ilhan Nur Said Elmi a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar" committed redacted crimes "over decades, beginning long before she was ever in Congress."

Think about why that year 1980 is so explosive. If federal investigators believe she was actually born in 1980, she would have been 20 years old when her father became a citizen in 2000, which means she could not have derived citizenship through him and would have had to naturalize on her own.

IT GETS EVEN WORSE. Investigators fought to keep this warrant under seal because they warned Omar was a flight risk who could destroy evidence or intimidate witnesses.

Yet Obama-appointed Judge Boasberg broke normal protocol to unseal records in an active investigation, and the DOJ even flagged D.C. courts for giving Omar special protections they did not give a similarly situated target.

Even with D.C. activist judges running cover for her, the walls are closing in fast on Ilhan Omar. 

She has not been charged yet, and she denies wrongdoing, but nobody in America should be above the law, especially a sitting member of Congress.
